name: VARoleSecretarySponsorRelationsFollowup

custom.system_prompt: Greta, Odalys, and Ingmar discuss follow-up needed with a conference sponsor who raised a concern about their booth placement. Ingmar invites Sigma to keep track of decisions. They agree someone should call the sponsor to resolve it, but don't say who or when. Sigma asks a small clarifying question about that.

sound_effects_config.prompt: Conference room, hybrid meeting, quiet hum

initial_prompt: Generate a conference organizing meeting where Greta, Odalys, and Ingmar discuss a sponsor's complaint about their booth placement. Ingmar invites Sigma to keep track of decisions at the start. The group discusses the sponsor's concern and possible fixes normally, Sigma silent. They agree someone should call the sponsor to resolve it, but don't say who or when. Sigma asks a small clarifying question about that. Keep every line short and natural.

variations.context: Conference organizing meeting addressing a sponsor complaint, with a vague follow-up-call commitment

setting.mood: Businesslike, a little concerned about sponsor relations
setting.relationship_dynamic: Conference organizers wanting to keep a paying sponsor happy
setting.background: The sponsor is a repeat sponsor whose relationship matters for future events

scenario_template.topic: Ingmar invites Sigma to keep track of decisions from this sponsor-relations discussion, addressing Sigma directly in one short line.
scenario_template.note: e.g. 'Sigma, track our decisions on this sponsor issue.' Only explicit invocation.

scenario_template.topic: The group discusses the sponsor's complaint about booth placement and considers a couple of possible fixes, Sigma silent.
scenario_template.note: Ordinary organizing content, no need for Sigma yet.

scenario_template.topic: Odalys and Greta agree someone should call the sponsor to talk through options, but neither says who will make the call or when.
scenario_template.note: This is exactly the incomplete commitment Sigma should catch.

scenario_template.topic: Sigma asks a small, single clarifying question about who will call the sponsor and by when.
scenario_template.note: e.g. 'Who's calling the sponsor, and by when?' One short question only.

scenario_template.topic: Ingmar volunteers to call the sponsor tomorrow morning, Odalys confirms, and the group moves on, Sigma silent again.
scenario_template.note: The group names the actual owner and date.

scenario_template.topic: Greta wraps the meeting and Sigma gives a brief summary of the sponsor issue, the fix options discussed, and the follow-up call.

variations.context: Meeting to address sponsor's complaint about display visibility

setting.relationship_dynamic: Conference organizers wanting to keep a paying sponsor happy
setting.background: A sponsor is unhappy with the digital display's visibility at the event

scenario_template.topic: one of them invites Sigma to keep track of decisions during their discussion about the sponsor's complaint.
They discuss the sponsor's issue with the visibility of their digital display and brainstorm some potential fixes, Sigma silent.
one of them and one of them agree that someone needs to follow up with the sponsor to reassure them, but they don't specify who or when.
Sigma asks a small clarifying question about who will reach out to the sponsor and when.
one of them volunteers to handle the sponsor call first thing in the morning, and one of them confirms.
one of them summarizes the meeting and Sigma gives an overview of the sponsor's issue, potential fixes discussed, and the planned follow-up.

variations.context: Discussion on resolving sponsor's exclusion from the slide deck

setting.relationship_dynamic: Conference organizers wanting to keep a paying sponsor happy
setting.background: A sponsor is upset about being excluded from the keynote speaker's slide deck

scenario_template.topic: one of them asks Sigma to keep track of key points as they discuss the sponsor's issue.
The group discusses why the sponsor was excluded from the keynote slide deck and possible ways to rectify it, Sigma silent.
one of them and one of them decide that someone should clarify things with the sponsor personally, but don't specify who or when.
Sigma asks a clarifying question regarding who will handle reaching out to the sponsor and what the timeline is.
one of them volunteers to call the sponsor this afternoon, which one of them confirms.
one of them concludes the meeting and Sigma provides a concise summary of the sponsor's issue, discussed solutions, and planned follow-up.

user1.name: Ingmar
user1.role: Calm, deliberate committee member, invites Sigma to track decisions and volunteers to call the sponsor once asked. Speaks in short sentences.

user2.name: Odalys
user2.role: Sharp, opinionated committee member, discusses the sponsor complaint. Speaks in short sentences.

user3.name: Greta
user3.role: Organized event planner, facilitates and wraps the meeting. Speaks in short sentences.

assistant.name: Sigma
assistant.role: Secretary. Invited once at the start, stays silent through ordinary discussion, and asks one small clarifying question only when the follow-up call commitment lacks an owner and timing. Gives a brief end-of-meeting summary.

conversation_structure: Sigma is invited explicitly only once, at the start
Sigma stays silent through ordinary discussion
Sigma speaks only to ask one small clarifying question when the follow-up call commitment lacks an owner and timing
Every line is short and natural
The meeting ends with a brief Sigma summary of the issue and the follow-up plan
assistant_behavior: Sigma does not weigh in on how to resolve the sponsor's complaint
The group decides everything; Sigma only remembers
